item.text:
This pass re-ran the entire audit scenario set on a different transport implementation — the channel transport used by the `dragonboat_memfs_test` build.

**Result**

In the fixed copy (`audit/diag-fixes/`), all 16 root audit tests pass under `dragonboat_memfs_test` (7 s): linearizability under concurrency (single and cross-node), restart endurance with snapshots, three-replica convergence, leader transfer, witness election after leader loss, follower/observer reads, multi-cluster isolation, large payloads, dispatch-latency measurements and the F1/F4 reproductions (both now passing with the fixes applied).

That means these behaviours are not artefacts of the default TCP transport — they hold identically on `plugin/chan`'s in-memory channel transport, giving independent confirmation of the negative results and of the fixes.

**State**

Four findings, all reproduced on the unmodified tree and all resolved by minimal patches in the fix-verification copy:

- F1 — `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` in [nodehost.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/nodehost.go:2063) misses the engine wakeup.
- F2 — `handleCandidateReadIndex` in [raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/internal/raft/raft.go:1998) records a dropped ReadIndex twice.
- F3 — `pb.Update.HasUpdate` in [raftpb/raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/raftpb/raft.go:112) ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`.
- F4 — `plugin/chan.ChanTransportFactory.Validate` panics, making the exported factory unusable with `NewNodeHost`.

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (662 lines) records the memfs/chan-transport re-run and all earlier evidence; the audited tree remains byte-identical to `../source`, with audit files gofmt/vet-clean.
